subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. Samuel waits until everyone has a bowl, then bows over his and says a grace, low, in the old words. Toby hasn't sat. He is standing at the end of the table with his tray, looking at the clock over the hatch. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.grace, version zulu+estrada (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Grace). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
